title: Microsoft Windows NtUserMagSetContextInformation Kernel State Corruption Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.
